recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core. If future edits to the extension definition are needed, make them in the FHIR Extension Pack; no current FHIR-core follow-up is required for FHIR-12309.
issue_request: FHIR-12309 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core MessageHeader and requested a core extension equivalent to HL7 v2 MSH-16 so a message instance can declare whether an application-level response is required always, only on error, only on success, or never.
initial_application: Core history shows the issue was applied: commit 3aaf0e56ad added the MessageHeader extension spreadsheet for #GF12309, commit 8e0c4de0f3 corrected the extension name and codes to messageheader-response-request / always, on-error, never, on-success, and commit 826db6e76e later aligned MessageDefinition.responseRequired with that value set.
additional_context: Commit dd468d4f17 removed the MessageHeader extension StructureDefinition and core IG reference from R5 core source as part of removing extensions from R5 source. The current FHIR Extension Pack source defines StructureDefinition/messageheader-response-request for MessageHeader with the requested MSH-16 description, valueCode, required binding, and min 0. Core still has active MessageHeader/MessageDefinition source and references the extension URL in $process-message guidance while keeping the aligned responseRequired binding and messageheader-response-request CodeSystem/ValueSet.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. Re-adding the extension StructureDefinition to core would duplicate the Extension Pack artifact and reverse the intentional source split.

Published issue and Zulip thread about core extension min cardinality; current Extension Pack definition has min 0.
